statement: The function returns a result r (so it does not fail), and r = true if and only if at least one of the following three conditions holds: (1) every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is uppercase; (2) every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is lowercase; (3) word[0] is uppercase and every byte word[i] with 1 <= i < len(word) is lowercase.
preconditions: word is a slice of bytes with 1 <= len(word) <= 100, and every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is an uppercase English letter (65 <= word[i] <= 90) or a lowercase English letter (97 <= word[i] <= 122).

statement: For every input word satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not panic, overflow, or index out of bounds.
preconditions: word is a slice of bytes with 1 <= len(word) <= 100, and every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is an uppercase English letter (65 <= word[i] <= 90) or a lowercase English letter (97 <= word[i] <= 122).

statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if it is not the case that word[0] is lowercase and word[1] is uppercase.
preconditions: word is a slice of bytes with 1 <= len(word) <= 100, every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is an uppercase English letter (65 <= word[i] <= 90) or a lowercase English letter (97 <= word[i] <= 122), and len(word) = 2.

preconditions: word is a slice of bytes with 1 <= len(word) <= 100, and every byte word[i] with 0 <= i < len(word) is an uppercase English letter (65 <= word[i] <= 90) or a lowercase English letter (97 <= word[i] <= 122).

statement: Let k be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(word) such that word[i] is uppercase. The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if k = len(word) or k = 0 or (k = 1 and word[0] is uppercase).

statement: Whenever detect_capital_use(word) returns a result r_word and detect_capital_use(other) returns a result r_other, we have r_word = r_other.
preconditions: word and other are slices of bytes with 1 <= len(word) <= 100, 1 <= len(other) <= 100, every byte of each is an uppercase English letter (65..90) or a lowercase English letter (97..122), len(word) = len(other), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(word), word[i] is uppercase if and only if other[i] is uppercase.
